title: DICTIONARYWDFLT DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated direct-encoder transaction controls for DRW_DictionaryWithDefault::encodeDwg; no producer or support claim

implementation.behavior: The encoder stages body, string, and handle streams, appends the default-entry hard-pointer handle to staged output, and publishes by swap only after successful encoding.
implementation.fixture_policy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added; all test data is generated in memory.

control_details: Each stream is seeded before encoding; rollback checks byte vectors, logical bit counts, and handle-occurrence ledgers for body, string, and handle streams.
Each reached injected failure must return false without throwing, after which the same object and buffers must retry to exact clean body/string/handle bytes.
The sweep continues to the first allocation offset that is not injected and compares successful output with a clean baseline.

validation.build_result: passed; target compiled with repository warning policy
validation.direct_selector_result: passed; reported 10, 16, 16, 22, 22, 22, and 22 reached injected failures for AC1012, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 respectively

limits: This validates local encoder transaction behavior for the generated default-entry profile only.
It does not establish independent producer field semantics, whole-DWG graph closure, output qualification, consumer interoperability, or native application acceptance.
No full suite or ASan suite was run; neither was needed for this isolated allocation rollback selector.
